mentions.author: philippeback
mentions.text: When you deal with large data sets (e.g. Hadoop/Spark...), BigO starts to hit badly. Dynamic Programming also requires you to have a clue about it. See https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQ5jsbhAv_M for some cool explanations.

mentions.author: dovin
mentions.storyTitle: Ask HN: What is your favorite YouTube channel for developers?
mentions.text: I really like the series of four lectures in the 2011 recording of the MIT Intro to Algorithms: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQ5jsbhAv_M&index=19&list=PL....

mentions.author: gbacon
mentions.text: You may also like a couple of lectures by Erik Demaine: Dynamic Programming I: Fibonacci, Shortest Paths https://youtu.be/OQ5jsbhAv_M Dynamic Programming II: Text Justification, Blackjack https://youtu.be/ENyox7kNKeY
